title: Naturality after fixing residue homology equivalences
statement: Given additive equivalences eK and eC as in the geometric comparison, there exist derived arrows a satisfying the induced homology naturality equation for every chain representative.

source.place: Tags 0B91, 0BF2, 01XK; parent steps 1, 2 and 4 on homology rather than cycles

proof.text: Use the empty-family elimination and, for a positive family, assemble the per-index arrows supplied by the fixed-index geometric naturality theorem using choice.
